datasets.name: ds_rafagas
queryLines:
SELECT b.fecha_ventana, date_trunc('MONTH', b.fecha_ventana) AS mes, n.nombre AS negocio, n.ciudad,
       n.categoria_principal, b.resenas_en_ventana, b.checkins_en_ventana
FROM workspace.yelp_gold.gld_business_anomaly_bursts b
JOIN workspace.yelp_gold.gld_dim_negocio n USING (business_id)
WHERE b.es_rafaga_sospechosa

datasets.name: ds_riesgo_nivel
queryLines:
SELECT clasificacion_riesgo AS nivel_riesgo, count(*) AS usuarios
FROM workspace.yelp_gold.gld_user_fraud_profile
GROUP BY 1

datasets.name: ds_riesgo_regla
queryLines:
SELECT concat('Regla ', cast(r.regla_id AS STRING), ' · ', coalesce(g.fraud_description, '****')) AS regla_fraude,
       count(*) AS usuarios
FROM (SELECT explode(reglas_activadas) AS regla_id FROM workspace.yelp_gold.gld_user_fraud_profile) r
LEFT JOIN workspace.yelp_gold.gld_trust_governance g ON g.fraud_rule_id = r.regla_id
GROUP BY 1

datasets.name: ds_resenas
queryLines:
SELECT date_trunc('MONTH', d.fecha) AS mes, n.ciudad, n.categoria_principal,
       count(*) AS resenas, sum(r.calificacion) AS suma_calificacion
FROM workspace.yelp_gold.gld_fact_resena r
JOIN workspace.yelp_gold.gld_dim_fecha d USING (fecha_id)
JOIN workspace.yelp_gold.gld_dim_negocio n USING (business_id)
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: ds_resenas_categoria
datasets.displayName: Reseñas de las 15 categorías con más volumen (REQ-04)
queryLines:
WITH top AS (
  SELECT n.categoria_principal FROM workspace.yelp_gold.gld_fact_resena r JOIN workspace.yelp_gold.gld_dim_negocio n USING (business_id)
  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 15
)
SELECT date_trunc('MONTH', d.fecha) AS mes, n.ciudad, n.categoria_principal,
       count(*) AS resenas, sum(CAST(r.es_extrema AS INT)) AS extremas, sum(r.util) AS votos_utiles
FROM workspace.yelp_gold.gld_fact_resena r
JOIN workspace.yelp_gold.gld_dim_fecha d USING (fecha_id)
JOIN workspace.yelp_gold.gld_dim_negocio n USING (business_id)
JOIN top USING (categoria_principal)
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: ds_checkins
queryLines:
SELECT date_trunc('MONTH', d.fecha) AS mes, d.dia_semana, concat(cast(d.dia_semana AS STRING), ' · ', d.nombre_dia) AS dia,
       n.ciudad, n.categoria_principal, sum(c.n_checkins) AS checkins
FROM workspace.yelp_gold.gld_fact_checkin_diario c
JOIN workspace.yelp_gold.gld_dim_fecha d USING (fecha_id)
JOIN workspace.yelp_gold.gld_dim_negocio n USING (business_id)
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: ds_calidad_ultima
datasets.displayName: Última ejecución de cada regla de calidad (REQ-06)
queryLines:
WITH ultima AS (
  SELECT regla_id, max(ejecucion_ts) AS ts FROM workspace.yelp_gov.dq_resultados
  WHERE regla_id <> 'DQ-900'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT r.regla_id, q.descripcion, q.dimension, q.criticidad, q.data_owner,
       round(r.pct_cumplimiento, 3) AS cumplimiento_pct, q.umbral_pct,
       CASE WHEN r.paso THEN 'En verde' ELSE 'En rojo' END AS estado, r.ejecucion_ts
FROM workspace.yelp_gov.dq_resultados r
JOIN ultima u ON u.regla_id = r.regla_id AND u.ts = r.ejecucion_ts
JOIN workspace.yelp_gov.dq_reglas q ON q.regla_id = r.regla_id

datasets.name: ds_calidad_historia
queryLines:
SELECT r.ejecucion_ts, q.dimension, avg(r.pct_cumplimiento) AS cumplimiento_pct,
       count_if(NOT r.paso) AS reglas_en_rojo
FROM workspace.yelp_gov.dq_resultados r
JOIN workspace.yelp_gov.dq_reglas q ON q.regla_id = r.regla_id
WHERE r.regla_id <> 'DQ-900'
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: ds_cobertura
queryLines:
SELECT
  (SELECT round(100 * count_if(descripcion_negocio IS NOT NULL AND trim(descripcion_negocio) <> '') / count(*), 1)
     FROM workspace.yelp_gov.diccionario_datos) AS pct_columnas_documentadas,
  (SELECT round(100 * count_if(data_owner IS NOT NULL) / count(*), 1) FROM workspace.yelp_gov.matriz_raci) AS pct_entidades_con_owner,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM workspace.yelp_gov.diccionario_datos) AS columnas,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM workspace.yelp_gov.matriz_raci) AS entidades

datasets.name: ds_alertas
datasets.displayName: Reglas de fraude y alertas de gobierno (REQ-09)
queryLines:
SELECT fraud_rule_id AS regla, entidad, fraud_description AS descripcion, rule_status AS estado_regla,
       n_casos_marcados, team_name AS equipo, team_status AS estado_equipo,
       coalesce(nullif(alerta_gobierno, ''), 'Ninguna') AS alerta_gobierno,
       CASE WHEN nullif(alerta_gobierno, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'Abierta' ELSE 'Sin alerta' END AS estado_alerta
FROM workspace.yelp_gold.gld_trust_governance

datasets.name: ds_pipeline
queryLines:
SELECT job_run_id, min(ejecucion_ts) AS inicio, count(*) AS tareas,
       count_if(estado <> 'SUCCESS') AS tareas_no_exitosas, sum(intentos - 1) AS reintentos,
       round(sum(duracion_seg) / 60, 1) AS minutos_computo,
       CASE WHEN count_if(estado <> 'SUCCESS') = 0 THEN 'Exitosa' ELSE 'Con fallas' END AS resultado
FROM workspace.yelp_gov.pipeline_bitacora
WHERE job_run_id RLIKE '^[0-9]+$'
GROUP BY job_run_id
